roles and responsibilities
each member commits to:

primary ownership: take lead responsibility for at least one project component per phase
secondary support: provide backup and review for at least one other member’s work
communication: respond to team messages within 24 hours on weekdays
meetings: attend all scheduled meetings or provide 48-hour advance notice of absence
deadlines: submit assigned work at least 24 hours before phase deadlines to allow for integration and review

communication protocol

primary channel: Instagram
response window: 24 hours (weekdays), 48 hours (weekends)
meeting platform: teams or in-person. Prioritize asynchronous communication.
file sharing: OneDrive

meeting schedule

quorum: minimum 4 members required for decisions
notes: rotating responsibility, shared within 24 hours

quality standards

all written work must be proofread before submission to team
citations in consistent format (APA/MLA as required)
no placeholder text or incomplete sections in shared drafts
all data and sources must be verifiable

accountability measures
performance expectations

complete assigned tasks by internal deadlines
communicate blockers immediately, not at deadline
review teammates’ work when assigned as backup

escalation process
level 1: direct conversation between affected members
level 2: full team discussion at next meeting
level 3: formal warning documented in writing
level 4: professor notification and peer evaluation impact
consequences for non-compliance

first violation: verbal warning, documented in meeting notes
second violation: written warning, copied to all members
third violation: reduced peer evaluation score recommendation
continued violations: professor consultation, potential removal from team credit

conflict resolution

disputes first addressed between parties directly
if unresolved within 48 hours, escalate to full team vote
majority decision binding
if team cannot resolve, professor mediation requested

amendment process
this contract may be amended by unanimous consent of all members, documented in writing.
